newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai completes first gold jewellery auction.
newsitem.headline: Dubai completes first gold jewellery auction.

text.p: Dubai Ports and Customs authority has carried out its first auction of gold jewellery, a customs official in the Gulf Arab emirate said on Tuesday.
The auction sold 3.996 kg of gold jewellery of mostly 22 carat purity and 4.5 kg of imitation jewellery which had arrived in Dubai from New Delhi by sea but remained unclaimed.
"It is the first time that we had this," the official said.
The sales raised 160,000 UAE dirhams ($43,572) and went to Dubai-based jeweller Damas.
The customs official added it was unlikely that gold auctions would become a regular event in Dubai.
Sales of confiscated gold in India are a regular and market moving event in India's bullion exchanges.
Dubai is a major gold centre, being the main feed supplier to India, the world's single largest bullion consumer.
